The app as built · current screens v0.1 · 6 November 2026

Drawn from the code after the UX_GAPS pass (A1–D17) and the core team and visibility change (6 Nov). A1 marks what changed and which gap it fixes. A fictional club and run; names are samples. Follows DESIGN_STANDARD.md and EXPERIENCE.md.

Who sees what

Who sees this team's work

Core team members on the project, and this team

This team sees the whole project

Off. Its volunteers see this team's work only

Tick to keep this team's work to itself, or to let its volunteers see the whole project.

  • Each committee sets who sees its work BIX Team.visibility. By default the core team members on the project see it; ticked, only the team, officers and core members do.
  • And what its volunteers see Team.access. Off, volunteers see their own team's work. On, the whole project, as Communications needs; new projects turn it on for Communications.
  • Only the team's lead, officers and core members can change these.
